scope: 考研英语高频核心词首批离线拓展
note: 共82个离线核心词条，按考研必考词单元持续扩充。 本次补充必考词 Unit1 缺失的 23 个词条，重点整理高频短语、固定搭配、中文释义及考研语境例句。 Unit2 第一批补充：mediate—abstract，共16个词条，强化媒介、教育、制度、社会议题等阅读语境中的固定搭配。

sentences: We should not abandon our efforts after one failure.
我们不应因一次失败就放弃努力。
The old factory was abandoned many years ago.
这家旧工厂多年前就被废弃了。
forms: abandoned（过去式/过去分词；被遗弃的）
confusables: abandon 更强调彻底丢弃；give up 常指停止尝试或努力

meanings: n. 使用权；接触（或获取）的机会
v. 访问；获取（计算机数据）
sentences: All students have access to the online library.
所有学生都可以使用这个在线图书馆。
The new system allows users to access information quickly.
新系统允许用户快速访问信息。
forms: accessible（adj. 可进入的；可使用的）
inaccessible（adj. 难以到达的；无法使用的）
confusables: access 是“进入/使用”；assess 是“评估”

sentences: Hard work alone does not guarantee that we will achieve our goals.
仅靠努力并不能保证我们实现目标。
The team achieved remarkable progress in a short time.
这个团队在短时间内取得了显著进展。
forms: achiever（n. 成功者；有成就的人）
confusables: achieve 强调努力后实现目标；acquire 强调获得或习得

sentences: He acknowledged that the decision had been difficult.
他承认这个决定很难作出。
The author acknowledges the help of her colleagues.
作者对同事们的帮助表示感谢。
forms: acknowledgment / acknowledgement（n. 承认；致谢；收件确认）
confusables: acknowledge 可指公开认可或确认；admit 常强调承认不情愿的事实

meanings: 学到；习得（技能、知识、语言等）
sentences: Children acquire language through daily interaction.
儿童通过日常互动习得语言。
The company plans to acquire a smaller competitor.
这家公司计划收购一家规模较小的竞争对手。
confusables: acquire 是“获得”；require 是“需要；要求”

sentences: People need time to adapt to a new environment.
人们需要时间来适应新环境。
The book was adapted for a younger audience.
这本书经过改编，以适合更年轻的读者。
confusables: adapt 是“适应/改编”；adopt 是“采纳/收养”

sentences: Climate change affects the lives of millions of people.
气候变化影响着数百万人的生活。
The report may affect future policy decisions.
这份报告可能会影响未来的政策决策。
confusables: affect 通常作动词“影响”；effect 通常作名词“影响/效果”

phrases: 有能力做某事；承担得起做某事
sentences: Many families cannot afford expensive housing.
许多家庭负担不起昂贵的住房。
The new technology affords researchers more flexibility.
这项新技术为研究人员提供了更大的灵活性。
confusables: afford 可表示“提供”，但 offer 更常用来表达主动提出或给予

meanings: v. 接近；着手处理；与……接洽
sentences: We need a different approach to the problem.
我们需要用另一种方法解决这个问题。
The researchers approached the question from several angles.
研究人员从多个角度着手研究这个问题。
forms: approachable（adj. 平易近人的；可接近的）
confusables: approach 可指整体思路或处理途径；method 更强调具体方法和步骤

sentences: The study assesses the impact of technology on education.
这项研究评估了技术对教育的影响。
Students are assessed on both their knowledge and practical skills.
学生的知识和实践技能都会受到评估。
confusables: assess 是“评估”；access 是“进入/使用”

sentences: We should not assume that everyone has the same needs.
我们不应假定每个人都有相同的需求。
She assumed responsibility for the project.
她承担起了这个项目的责任。
confusables: assume 常指未经证明地假定；presume 常含有依据或较大可能性的推断

sentences: Students can benefit from regular feedback.
学生可以从定期反馈中受益。
The policy is designed for the benefit of the whole community.
这项政策旨在造福整个社区。
forms: benefit（过去式/过去分词：benefited 或 benefitted）
confusables: benefit 强调好处或受益；profit 常指经济利润或从中获利

sentences: The report claims that the new method is more effective.
报告声称这种新方法更有效。
Anyone who finds the bag can claim it at the front desk.
任何找到这个包的人都可以到前台认领。
confusables: claim 常表达有待证实的主张；declare 更强调正式宣布

meanings: n. 关心的事；重要的事
v. 涉及；与……有关；使担忧
sentences: There is growing concern about the cost of education.
人们越来越担心教育成本问题。
The article is concerned with changes in social behavior.
这篇文章讨论的是社会行为的变化。
confusables: concern 是“涉及/使担忧”；consider 是“考虑”

sentences: Regular exercise contributes to better health.
经常锻炼有助于改善健康。
Several factors contributed to the success of the project.
多种因素促成了这个项目的成功。
confusables: contribute to 表示“促成”；attribute A to B 表示“把A归因于B”

sentences: The number of visitors has declined in recent years.
近年来，游客数量有所下降。
She declined the invitation because she was busy.
她因为很忙而婉拒了邀请。
confusables: decline 可表示趋势性衰退或婉拒；decrease 主要表示数量减少

sentences: There is little evidence to support this argument.
几乎没有证据支持这一论点。
The researchers collected evidence from several independent sources.
研究人员从多个独立来源收集了证据。
confusables: evidence 是支持判断的证据；proof 通常指足以证明结论的确凿证据

sentences: It is important to maintain a healthy balance between work and rest.
保持工作与休息之间的健康平衡很重要。
The researchers maintain that more data is needed.
研究人员坚持认为还需要更多数据。
confusables: maintain 强调维持现状；sustain 强调支撑或使某事持续

sentences: Researchers obtained the data from public records.
研究人员从公开记录中获得了这些数据。
You must obtain permission before using the material.
使用这些材料之前必须获得许可。
confusables: obtain 强调取得某物；attain 强调经过努力达到目标或水平

sentences: Education plays a significant role in social development.
教育在社会发展中发挥着重要作用。
The study found a significant difference between the two groups.
研究发现两组之间存在显著差异。
forms: insignificant（adj. 不重要的；微不足道的）
confusables: significant 常强调程度、影响或统计意义上的显著；important 强调重要性

sentences: It takes time to adjust to a new working environment.
适应新的工作环境需要时间。
The company adjusted its strategy in response to market changes.
公司针对市场变化调整了策略。
confusables: adjust 常指对细节或状态作调整；adapt 强调适应新环境或改编

meanings: n. 可供选择的事物；替代方案
adj. 可替代的；非传统的
sentences: We need to find an alternative to expensive medical treatment.
我们需要找到昂贵医疗方案的替代办法。
There is no alternative but to reconsider the plan.
除了重新考虑计划，我们别无选择。
forms: alternatively（adv. 或者；作为另一种选择）
confusables: alternative 常强调替代性选择；option 泛指可选项目

sentences: Teachers should choose materials appropriate for their students.
教师应选择适合学生的材料。
The government took appropriate measures to reduce the risk.
政府采取了适当措施来降低风险。
confusables: appropriate 强调与具体情境相适合；proper 强调符合规则或标准

sentences: Climate change presents a serious challenge to agriculture.
气候变化给农业带来了严峻挑战。
The findings challenge the traditional view of intelligence.
这些发现对传统的智力观提出了质疑。
confusables: challenge 常包含需要应对的任务或考验；difficulty 强调困难本身

sentences: The organization is committed to protecting the environment.
该组织致力于保护环境。
He committed a serious error in the calculation.
他在计算中犯了一个严重错误。
forms: committed（adj. 尽心尽力的；坚定的）
committee（n. 委员会，词形相近但词义不同）
confusables: commit 常表示正式承担责任或投入；promise 强调作出承诺

sentences: We should consider the long-term effects of this decision.
我们应该考虑这一决定的长期影响。
Many people consider education a basic right.
许多人认为教育是一项基本权利。
confusables: consider 可直接接宾语或从句；regard 常见结构为 regard A as B

sentences: It is difficult to define success in a single sentence.
很难用一句话定义成功。
The law clearly defines the responsibilities of each party.
法律明确界定了各方的责任。
confusables: define 说明概念的含义或边界；describe 描述事物的特征

sentences: Many English words derive from Latin.
许多英语单词源于拉丁语。
The researchers derived a general rule from the observations.
研究人员从观察结果中推导出一条普遍规律。
forms: derivative（n. 衍生物；导数 adj. 派生的）
confusables: derive 是“得到/源于”；deprive 是“剥夺”

sentences: The charity distributed food among the affected families.
慈善机构向受灾家庭分发了食物。
The species is widely distributed across the region.
这一物种广泛分布于该地区。
confusables: distribute 是“分发/分布”；contribute 是“贡献/促成”

sentences: The university established a research center in 2010.
这所大学于2010年建立了一个研究中心。
Further evidence is needed to establish the cause of the problem.
还需要更多证据来查明问题的原因。
confusables: establish 可指建立制度、关系或事实；found 更常指创办组织或机构

sentences: Experts estimate that the project will take two years.
专家估计这个项目需要两年时间。
The initial cost estimate was too low.
最初的成本估算过低。
confusables: estimate 侧重估算数量或价值；evaluate 侧重评价质量、价值或效果

sentences: Cost is an important factor in the decision.
成本是作出这一决定时的重要因素。
We must factor in the effects of inflation.
我们必须把通货膨胀的影响考虑在内。
forms: factorial（n. 阶乘 adj. 因子的）
confusables: factor 指影响结果的因素；feature 指事物本身的特征

sentences: One important feature of the system is its flexibility.
该系统的一个重要特点是灵活性。
The magazine featured an interview with the scientist.
这本杂志刊登了对那位科学家的专访。
confusables: feature 常指可观察到的特点；characteristic 常指典型属性或特性

sentences: The researchers identified three major causes of the failure.
研究人员查明了失败的三个主要原因。
Readers may identify with the main character.
读者可能会对主人公产生共鸣。
forms: identification（n. 识别；身份证明；认同）
confusables: identify 强调确认身份或性质；recognize 强调认出熟悉的人或事物

sentences: The results indicate that the new approach is effective.
结果表明，这种新方法是有效的。
A red light indicates that the battery is low.
红灯表示电池电量不足。
confusables: indicate 常指明确显示；imply 常指间接暗示

meanings: 需要；必然包含（某种结果或活动）
sentences: The project involves cooperation among several departments.
这个项目需要几个部门之间的合作。
More than one hundred volunteers were involved in the study.
一百多名志愿者参与了这项研究。
forms: involved（adj. 复杂的；参与其中的）
confusables: involve 强调必然牵涉或需要；include 强调把某项列入整体

sentences: The accident occurred shortly after midnight.
事故发生在午夜刚过不久。
A similar idea occurred to several researchers independently.
几位研究人员各自独立地想到了类似的观点。
confusables: occur 较正式，常用于书面语；happen 更口语化

sentences: The technology has the potential to transform education.
这项技术有可能改变教育。
We should consider the potential risks before acting.
行动前我们应该考虑潜在风险。
confusables: potential 强调尚未实现但具备发展的可能；possible 泛指有可能发生

sentences: The design is based on a simple scientific principle.
这一设计基于一个简单的科学原理。
In principle, everyone should have equal access to education.
原则上，每个人都应享有平等的受教育机会。
confusables: principle 是“原则/原理”；principal 是“主要的”或“负责人/校长”

sentences: The job requires strong communication skills.
这份工作需要较强的沟通能力。
Applicants are required to provide proof of identity.
申请人必须提供身份证明。
confusables: require 是“需要/要求”；acquire 是“获得/习得”

sentences: The sun radiates heat and light.
太阳散发热量和光。
Her face seemed to radiate happiness.
她的脸上似乎洋溢着幸福。
forms: radiant（adj. 容光焕发的；光芒四射的）
confusables: radiate 强调向四周发散；emit 泛指发出声音、光、气体等

meanings: 容光焕发的；喜气洋洋的
sentences: She gave us a radiant smile when she heard the news.
听到这个消息时，她向我们露出了灿烂的笑容。
The room was filled with radiant sunlight.
房间里充满了明亮的阳光。
confusables: radiant 常强调光芒或神采；brilliant 还可表示才华出众、极聪明

meanings: 激进的； radical 的政治立场
n. 激进分子；（化学）基团、游离基
sentences: The new policy represents a radical change in direction.
这项新政策代表着方向上的根本转变。
We need to address the problem at its most radical level.
我们需要从最根本的层面解决这个问题。
confusables: radical 强调彻底、剧烈或激进；fundamental 强调基础性和根本重要性

meanings: v. 反对；不赞成（常接 to）
sentences: Some residents object to building a factory nearby.
一些居民反对在附近建厂。
The object of the experiment is to test the theory.
实验的目的是检验这一理论。
confusables: object 作名词可指物体或目标；objective 常指具体目标，也可作形容词“客观的”

meanings: n. 目标；目的；（军事）攻击目标
adj. 客观的；不带个人感情的
adj. 基于事实的；客观存在的
sentences: The main objective is to improve public health.
主要目标是改善公众健康。
Researchers should remain objective when interpreting the results.
研究人员在解释结果时应保持客观。
forms: object（n. 对象；目标；v. 反对）
confusables: objective 指基于事实的客观判断；subjective 指受个人感受或观点影响的主观判断

meanings: 反对的理由；不赞成之处
sentences: Several members raised objections to the proposal.
几位成员对这项提议提出了异议。
I have no objection to changing the schedule.
我不反对调整日程。
forms: objectionable（adj. 令人反感的；不合意的）
confusables: objection 常指具体异议或反对理由；opposition 常指持续的反对立场或力量

phrases: have an obligation to do sth.
sentences: Parents have an obligation to protect their children.
父母有责任保护自己的孩子。
The agreement creates a legal obligation for both parties.
这项协议使双方都承担法律义务。
confusables: obligation 强调必须履行的义务；responsibility 强调应承担的职责或责任

meanings: 迫使；使不得不（常用被动）
帮忙；施恩于（常见于 oblige sb.）
phrases: 不得不做某事；有义务做某事
sentences: The law obliges companies to protect customer data.
法律要求企业保护客户数据。
Could you oblige me with a copy of the report?
您能帮我提供一份报告吗？
confusables: oblige 常指因规则、责任或情势而使某人不得不做；force 强调强制力量

meanings: adj. 鲜为人知的；不出名的
adj. 难以理解的；含糊的
sentences: The meaning of the passage is rather obscure.
这段文字的意思相当晦涩。
Clouds obscured the view of the mountains.
云层遮住了群山的景色。
confusables: obscure 强调难懂、鲜为人知或被遮蔽；vague 强调表达不明确、不具体

sentences: Careful observation is essential to scientific research.
仔细观察对科学研究至关重要。
The doctor kept the patient under observation overnight.
医生让病人留院观察了一夜。
confusables: observation 侧重观察和记录；experiment 侧重通过控制条件进行实验

sentences: Scientists observed changes in the behavior of the animals.
科学家观察到了这些动物行为上的变化。
All employees must observe the safety regulations.
所有员工都必须遵守安全规定。
forms: observant（adj. 善于观察的；机警的）
confusables: observe 常指有目的、持续或仔细地观察；notice 强调注意到某事

meanings: 令人无法摆脱的念头；执念
sentences: His obsession with details sometimes slows the project down.
他对细节的过度执着有时会拖慢项目进度。
For some people, social media has become an obsession.
对一些人来说，社交媒体已经成了一种痴迷。
forms: obsessed（adj. 着迷的；念念不忘的）
confusables: obsession 常含过度、难以摆脱的意味；passion 多指强烈而积极的热情

meanings: 废弃不用的；不再使用的
sentences: Rapid innovation can make existing technology obsolete.
快速创新可能使现有技术变得过时。
The old regulations are now obsolete.
旧规定如今已经失效。
confusables: obsolete 强调已不再使用或被替代；outdated 泛指不再新颖或不合时宜

meanings: 不言自明的；容易理解的
过于明显而缺乏新意的
sentences: It is obvious that education affects social development.
显然，教育会影响社会发展。
The solution may seem obvious, but it is often overlooked.
这个解决办法看似显而易见，却常常被忽略。
confusables: obvious 强调容易看出；evident 常强调有证据或迹象表明

meanings: adj. 理想的；完美的；最合适的
n. 理想；典范；完美标准
sentences: There is no single ideal solution to every social problem.
并不存在适用于所有社会问题的唯一理想方案。
The ideal candidate should have both experience and creativity.
理想的候选人应兼具经验和创造力。
confusables: ideal 强调最符合某种目标或条件；perfect 强调没有缺点或错误

meanings: 一套政治、经济或社会信念
sentences: Political ideology can influence public policy.
政治意识形态可能影响公共政策。
The book examines the ideology behind the movement.
这本书探讨了这一运动背后的思想体系。
forms: ideological（adj. 思想上的；意识形态的）
confusables: ideology 是一套系统的思想或信念；ideal 是理想或完美标准

meanings: 完全相同的；一模一样的
同一的；同一个的（常用 identical to/with）
sentences: The two versions are almost identical in content.
这两个版本在内容上几乎完全相同。
The fingerprints were found to be identical.
这些指纹被发现完全一致。
confusables: identical 表示完全相同；similar 表示相似但不一定相同

sentences: The system allows quick identification of potential risks.
该系统可以快速识别潜在风险。
Visitors must show identification at the entrance.
访客必须在入口处出示身份证明。
confusables: identification 是识别或确认的过程/证明；identity 是身份或本质特征

sentences: Language plays an important role in cultural identity.
语言在文化认同中发挥着重要作用。
The police are trying to establish the identity of the victim.
警方正在努力确认受害者的身份。
confusables: identity 指身份或特性；identification 指识别、确认身份的行为或证明

meanings: 报纸；（尤指专业领域的）刊物
sentences: The findings were published in a leading scientific journal.
研究结果发表在一本知名科学期刊上。
She keeps a journal to record her daily thoughts.
她通过写日记记录每天的想法。
confusables: journal 常指学术期刊或个人日志；magazine 多指面向大众的杂志

sentences: The product carries a label showing its country of origin.
产品贴有标明原产国的标签。
It is unfair to label someone as a failure after one mistake.
仅凭一次错误就把某人称为失败者是不公平的。
forms: labeller / labeler（n. 贴标签者；标签机）
confusables: label 常指商品或概念的标签/分类；tag 常指附加的小标签或标记

meanings: n. 时间间隔；滞后现象
sentences: Wages have failed to keep up with prices and continue to lag behind.
工资未能跟上物价，仍然处于落后状态。
There is often a time lag between investment and economic growth.
投资与经济增长之间通常存在时间差。
confusables: lag 强调落后于预期或他者；delay 强调某事被推迟或耽搁

phrases: 在很大程度上应对……负责
sentences: The success of the project was largely due to teamwork.
这个项目的成功主要归功于团队合作。
The region is largely dependent on agriculture.
该地区在很大程度上依赖农业。
confusables: largely 强调整体程度或占比很大；mainly 强调主要部分或主要原因

meanings: adj. 侧面的；横向的；侧向的
n. 侧向移动；横向传球（体育）
sentences: The design allows lateral movement while maintaining stability.
这种设计在保持稳定性的同时允许横向移动。
Lateral thinking can help people find creative solutions.
横向思维有助于人们找到创造性的解决方案。
confusables: lateral 表示侧向或水平的；vertical 表示垂直方向的

meanings: adj. 后者的；两者中后面的
sentences: Of the two proposals, the latter is more practical.
在这两项提议中，后者更为实际。
The latter part of the report focuses on social effects.
报告的后半部分着重讨论社会影响。
confusables: latter 指两者中的后者；later 表示时间上更晚

sentences: Everyone is equal before the law.
法律面前人人平等。
The law requires companies to provide accurate information.
法律要求企业提供准确信息。
confusables: law 通常指由国家制定并执行的法律；rule 可指范围更广的规则或规定

sentences: The company faced a lawsuit over the safety of its products.
这家公司因产品安全问题面临诉讼。
The two sides agreed to settle the lawsuit out of court.
双方同意庭外和解这起诉讼。
forms: sued（v. 起诉的过去式/过去分词）
confusables: lawsuit 指诉讼案件或法律行动；trial 指法庭审理过程

sentences: The study reveals the magnitude of the social changes.
这项研究揭示了社会变革的巨大规模。
Few people understood the magnitude of the disaster at first.
起初很少有人意识到这场灾难的严重程度。
confusables: magnitude 强调规模、程度或量值；dimension 强调尺寸、维度或方面

sentences: A microscope can magnify objects that are too small to see clearly.
显微镜可以放大那些肉眼无法看清的物体。
Small errors may be magnified by poor communication.
沟通不畅可能会放大一些小错误。
confusables: magnify 常指借助工具放大或夸大；enlarge 泛指尺寸、范围或规模变大

sentences: The museum is famous for its magnificent architecture.
这座博物馆以其宏伟的建筑而闻名。
The team made a magnificent effort to complete the project.
团队为完成项目付出了卓越的努力。
confusables: magnificent 常强调宏伟壮观或令人惊叹；splendid 泛指极好、出色或华丽

meanings: adj. 主要的；重要的；较大的
n. 专业；主修学生；少校
sentences: Education is a major factor in social mobility.
教育是社会流动的重要因素。
She plans to major in computer science.
她计划主修计算机科学。
forms: majorly（adv. 非正式：非常；主要地）
confusables: major 强调重要性或规模较大；main 强调最主要、最核心的部分

sentences: The vast majority of participants supported the proposal.
绝大多数参与者支持这项提议。
The decision was approved by a large majority.
这项决定以多数票获得通过。
confusables: majority 通常指超过一半的群体或数量；most 泛指大部分，语法使用更灵活

sentences: The new policy may make it easier for small businesses to grow.
新政策可能使小企业更容易发展。
It takes time to make a well-informed decision.
作出一个有充分依据的决定需要时间。
confusables: make 常强调创造、形成结果或产品；do 常强调执行活动、任务或工作

sentences: The central theme of the novel is the search for identity.
这部小说的中心主题是对身份认同的探寻。
The article explores the theme of social inequality.
这篇文章探讨了社会不平等这一主题。
confusables: theme 强调贯穿作品或讨论的核心思想；topic 指具体讨论的话题

sentences: The theory provides a useful framework for understanding social behavior.
这一理论为理解社会行为提供了有用框架。
In theory, the plan should reduce costs.
理论上，这项计划应该能够降低成本。
confusables: theory 是经过大量证据支持的系统解释；hypothesis 是有待检验的假设

meanings: 理论上成立的；假设性的
纯理论的（与实际应用相对）
sentences: The course combines theoretical knowledge with practical training.
这门课程把理论知识与实践训练结合起来。
The proposal is attractive in theory but difficult to implement.
这项提议理论上很有吸引力，但实施起来很困难。
confusables: theoretical 强调理论层面；practical 强调实际应用和操作

sentences: Early therapy can improve the quality of life for patients.
早期治疗能够改善患者的生活质量。
The study examines the effectiveness of cognitive behavioral therapy.
这项研究考察认知行为疗法的有效性。
forms: therapist（n. 治疗师；心理治疗师）
therapeutic（adj. 治疗的；有益健康的）
confusables: therapy 常指系统的疗法或治疗过程；treatment 泛指医疗处理或治疗

sentences: Relevant experience is as important as formal qualifications.
相关经验与正式资历同样重要。
The position requires a professional qualification.
这个职位要求具备专业资格。
confusables: qualification 指资格或资历；quality 指品质、质量或特性

sentences: Applicants must qualify for the position through relevant experience.
申请人必须凭借相关经验达到该职位的资格要求。
Only the top teams qualify for the final round.
只有排名靠前的队伍才能进入决赛阶段。
confusables: qualify 指达到资格标准；certify 指由权威机构正式证明或认证

meanings: adj. 优质的；高质量的（常作定语）
sentences: Education can improve both productivity and quality of life.
教育能够提高生产力和生活质量。
The company introduced stricter quality control measures.
公司引入了更严格的质量控制措施。
confusables: quality 指质量或品质；quantity 指数量

meanings: 定性的；从性质角度进行的
强调特征、属性而非数量的
sentences: The researchers used interviews to conduct qualitative research.
研究人员通过访谈开展定性研究。
There is a qualitative difference between the two approaches.
这两种方法之间存在性质上的差异。
confusables: qualitative 关注性质和特征；quantitative 关注数量和可测量的数据

meanings: n. 安全措施；保护机制
sentences: Strong laws are needed to safeguard personal information.
需要强有力的法律来保护个人信息。
The system includes safeguards against unauthorized access.
该系统设有防止未经授权访问的安全措施。
confusables: safeguard 常强调预防风险的保障措施；protect 泛指保护人或事物免受伤害

meanings: 从事新闻采编与报道的人
sentences: The journalist questioned the accuracy of the official report.
这名记者质疑了官方报告的准确性。
Investigative journalists play an important role in public life.
调查记者在公共生活中发挥着重要作用。
forms: journalistic（adj. 新闻的；新闻工作者的）
confusables: journalist 负责采访和报道；editor 负责审阅、编辑内容

meanings: （尤指漫长或艰难的）过程；历程
sentences: The journey towards equality requires patience and persistent effort.
迈向平等的历程需要耐心和持续努力。
The train journey takes approximately three hours.
乘火车旅行大约需要三个小时。
confusables: journey 通常指一次具体行程或历程；travel 泛指旅行这一活动

sentences: We should not judge people solely by their appearance.
我们不应该仅凭外表判断一个人。
It is difficult to judge whether the policy has been effective.
很难判断这项政策是否有效。
confusables: judge 可指作出判断或裁决；evaluate 更强调系统评估价值或效果

sentences: Good judgement depends on both experience and careful reasoning.
良好的判断力既依赖经验，也依赖谨慎推理。
The final judgement will be announced next week.
最终判决将于下周公布。
confusables: judgement 强调判断过程或判断力；decision 强调最终作出的决定

sentences: An independent judicial system is essential to the rule of law.
独立的司法制度对于法治至关重要。
The decision is subject to judicial review.
这一决定须接受司法审查。
forms: judiciary（n. 司法部门；法官群体）
confusables: judicial 特指司法或法院相关；legal 泛指法律层面的

phrases: 由十二人组成的陪审团
sentences: The jury found the defendant not guilty.
陪审团裁定被告无罪。
A panel of experts acted as the jury for the competition.
专家小组担任了这场比赛的评审团。
confusables: jury 通常由成员共同评议事实；judge 是主持审判并依法裁决的法官

sentences: The case falls within the jurisdiction of the local court.
此案属于当地法院的管辖范围。
National laws may differ across jurisdictions.
不同司法管辖区的国家法律可能有所不同。
forms: jurisdictional（adj. 管辖权的；司法管辖的）
confusables: jurisdiction 指法律或制度规定的管辖范围；authority 强调权力或权威

sentences: Equal access to education is an important issue of social justice.
平等接受教育的机会是社会正义的重要议题。
The new evidence helped bring the criminal to justice.
新证据有助于将罪犯绳之以法。
confusables: justice 常涉及法律、制度和道德正义；fairness 强调公平对待

phrases: 做某事是有正当理由的
sentences: Economic benefits alone cannot justify environmental damage.
仅凭经济利益不足以证明环境破坏是合理的。
The researchers justified their conclusion with further evidence.
研究人员用进一步的证据为其结论提供了依据。
confusables: justify 旨在证明行为或观点合理；explain 旨在说明原因或过程

sentences: Regular maintenance can extend the life of public facilities.
定期维护能够延长公共设施的使用寿命。
The maintenance of social stability requires public cooperation.
维护社会稳定需要公众的合作。
confusables: maintenance 强调持续维护和保持正常运行；preservation 强调保护原状

sentences: Strict safety standards can reduce workplace accidents.
严格的安全标准能够减少工作场所事故。
Public safety should be considered when new technologies are introduced.
引入新技术时应考虑公共安全。
confusables: safety 多指免受事故或危险伤害；security 多指免受威胁、犯罪或攻击

sentences: The proposal received savage criticism from environmental groups.
这项提议遭到了环保组织的猛烈批评。
The documentary examines the impact of savage conflicts on civilians.
这部纪录片探讨了残酷冲突对平民的影响。
confusables: savage 常强调残酷、野蛮或猛烈；violent 强调使用暴力或造成伤害

sentences: Early warnings can save lives during natural disasters.
在自然灾害中，预警能够挽救生命。
Public transport helps save energy and reduce pollution.
公共交通有助于节约能源并减少污染。
confusables: save 可指挽救、节省或储存；rescue 主要指从危险中营救

meanings: 储蓄；存款（常用复数 savings）
sentences: The new system brings significant cost savings to the company.
新系统为公司带来了显著的成本节约。
Her life savings were invested in the small business.
她的毕生积蓄被投入了这家小企业。
confusables: saving 强调节省下来的资源或金额；economy 可指节约，也可指经济体系

sentences: The policy was introduced on a national scale.
这项政策在全国范围内推行。
Researchers are trying to scale up the experiment.
研究人员正尝试扩大实验规模。
confusables: scale 强调大小、程度或数量级；scope 强调范围或涉及的领域

meanings: 活动领域；界面（常用 the scene）
phrases: at the scene of the accident
sentences: Police arrived at the scene shortly after the accident.
事故发生后不久，警察便赶到了现场。
Important decisions are sometimes made behind the scenes.
重要决定有时是在幕后作出的。
confusables: scene 指具体场景或现场；scenery 指自然风景或舞台布景

sentences: Tourism can bring income to regions with attractive natural scenery.
旅游业能够为自然风光优美的地区带来收入。
The train offers passengers views of spectacular mountain scenery.
乘坐这趟列车，乘客可以欣赏壮丽的山景。
confusables: scenery 常指所看到的风景整体；landscape 更强调地貌或景观构成

sentences: Students should be allowed to learn at their own pace.
应该允许学生按照自己的节奏学习。
Technology is changing at a pace that challenges existing rules.
技术正以挑战现有规则的速度发生变化。
confusables: pace 常涉及步调、节奏或进展；speed 主要表示运动或变化的速度

sentences: A panel of experts evaluated the proposed research projects.
专家小组评估了拟议的研究项目。
The device is operated through a simple control panel.
这台设备通过一个简单的控制面板操作。
forms: panelist（n. 专题讨论小组成员）
confusables: panel 常指为特定任务组成的小组或面板；committee 通常指正式委员会

sentences: The report provides a panorama of recent changes in the labor market.
这份报告概述了劳动力市场近期的变化。
Visitors can enjoy a panoramic view from the top of the tower.
游客可以从塔顶欣赏全景。
confusables: panorama 常强调广阔、全面的景象；overview 强调对主题的概括性介绍

sentences: The study does not prove that the treatment is effective.
这项研究并不能证明该疗法有效。
The new method proved to be more reliable than the old one.
事实证明，这种新方法比旧方法更可靠。
confusables: prove 强调提供证据证明结论；verify 强调核实某事是否准确或真实

meanings: 规定；作出安排（法律或协议中）
sentences: Public libraries provide citizens with access to information.
公共图书馆为市民提供获取信息的渠道。
The agreement provides for regular reviews of the policy.
协议规定定期审查该政策。
confusables: provide 泛指提供所需之物或服务；supply 常强调持续供应物资

meanings: 提供了的；已备有的（过去分词用法）
sentences: The plan can succeed provided that sufficient resources are available.
只要有足够的资源，这项计划就能够成功。
The service is free, provided that users register in advance.
只要用户提前注册，这项服务就是免费的。
confusables: 两者都可表示“只要”；provided that 在正式书面语中更常见

sentences: An independent organization was invited to mediate the dispute.
一家独立机构受邀调解这场争端。
Social institutions can mediate between individuals and the state.
社会制度能够在个人与国家之间发挥中介作用。
confusables: mediate 强调居中协调以解决分歧；intervene 泛指介入某事

sentences: Meditation may help people manage stress and improve concentration.
冥想可能有助于人们管理压力、提高注意力。
Her meditation on the meaning of work led to a change in career.
她对工作意义的思考促使她改变了职业方向。
confusables: meditation 常指专注的沉思或冥想；reflection 强调回顾、反思

sentences: Language is a powerful medium for transmitting culture.
语言是传承文化的有力媒介。
The government needs to find a happy medium between growth and environmental protection.
政府需要在经济增长与环境保护之间找到折中办法。
forms: media（n. 媒体；medium 的复数形式之一）
confusables: medium 强调传播或表达的媒介；means 强调实现目的的方法或手段

meanings: 媒体；传播媒介（medium 的复数）
sentences: Social media have changed the way people obtain information.
社交媒体改变了人们获取信息的方式。
The issue attracted considerable media attention.
这一问题引起了媒体的广泛关注。
confusables: media 范围较广，包括电视、网络等；press 通常指新闻出版业或新闻界

sentences: The report provides an elaborate account of the causes of inequality.
这份报告详细说明了不平等产生的原因。
The author elaborated on the social consequences of the policy.
作者进一步阐述了这项政策的社会后果。
forms: elaboration（n. 详尽阐述；精心制作）
confusables: elaborate 强调细致、精心设计；complicated 强调复杂难懂

meanings: （论证、解决方案）简明而有效的
sentences: The researcher proposed an elegant solution to a difficult problem.
研究人员为一个难题提出了巧妙的解决方案。
An elegant theory explains complex phenomena with simple principles.
精妙的理论用简单原理解释复杂现象。
confusables: elegant 可指设计或思想简洁精妙；graceful 多强调动作或姿态优美

sentences: Trust is a key element of successful cooperation.
信任是成功合作的关键要素。
The human element should not be ignored when designing new technology.
设计新技术时不应忽视人的因素。
confusables: element 指构成整体的组成部分；factor 指影响结果的因素

sentences: Students need a firm grasp of elementary mathematical concepts.
学生需要牢固掌握基础数学概念。
The problem is not as elementary as it first appears.
这个问题并不像最初看起来那么简单。
confusables: elementary 常指初级或基础层次；fundamental 强调根本性、基础性

sentences: The new measures aim to eliminate barriers to education.
新措施旨在消除教育障碍。
Researchers must eliminate alternative explanations before accepting the hypothesis.
研究人员在接受该假设之前必须排除其他解释。
confusables: eliminate 强调彻底排除或使不再存在；remove 强调移走或去除

meanings: 废除；取消（制度、法律、习俗）
sentences: Many reformers campaigned to abolish discriminatory laws.
许多改革者发起运动，要求废除歧视性法律。
The government decided to abolish the outdated system.
政府决定废除这套过时的制度。
forms: abolitionist（n. 废奴主义者；废除主义者）
confusables: abolish 通常指废除制度、法律或习俗；cancel 常指取消计划、活动或订单

sentences: In the absence of reliable data, the conclusion remains uncertain.
由于缺乏可靠数据，这一结论仍不确定。
Her prolonged absence affected the team's performance.
她长期缺席影响了团队的表现。
confusables: absence 强调不在或不存在；lack 强调缺少所需之物

phrases: 擅自缺席；未经许可离开
sentences: Several members were absent from the meeting.
有几名成员没有出席会议。
The report was notable for its absent discussion of social costs.
这份报告的显著问题在于没有讨论社会成本。
confusables: absent 常指人未到场或某物缺乏；missing 强调找不到或失踪

sentences: Studying abroad can expose students to different academic cultures.
出国留学能让学生接触不同的学术文化。
The news quickly spread abroad through online networks.
这一消息通过网络迅速传播开来。
confusables: abroad 表示在国外；aboard 表示在船、飞机或火车上

meanings: 绝对真理或绝对事物（名词）
sentences: Few social questions can be answered with absolute certainty.
很少有社会问题能够得到绝对确定的答案。
The protection of basic rights should not depend on absolute political power.
基本权利的保护不应取决于绝对政治权力。
forms: absolutism（n. 专制主义；绝对主义）
confusables: absolute 强调不受限制或没有例外；complete 强调完整、全部

sentences: Children absorb language through interaction with others.
儿童通过与他人互动习得语言。
Small businesses may struggle to absorb rising energy costs.
小企业可能难以承担不断上涨的能源成本。
confusables: absorb 强调吸收或接纳；digest 强调消化、理解并整理信息

sentences: Abstract ideas become meaningful when connected with practical experience.
抽象思想与实践经验联系起来时才会变得有意义。
The article begins with an abstract summarizing its main findings.
文章以一段概述主要研究发现的摘要开篇。
confusables: abstract 强调脱离具体事物；theoretical 强调基于理论而非实践
